blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — More than 200 foreign nationals were arrested by the Bureau of Immigration (BI) over suspected involvement in Philippine Offshore Gaming Operator (Pogo)-related activities in Zamboanga Sibugay, in what authorities considered the “largest Pogo bust” of the year so far. According to the BI on Saturday, simultaneous operations were conducted in Barangay Kimos in Siay and Barangay Tandiong Muslim in Alicia last Friday, leading to the arrest of 244 foreigners, most of whom were Chinese. “At the Siay operation, BI teams apprehended 113 foreign nationals, consisting of 110 Chinese nationals, two Cambodians, and one Hong Kong national.
